notes: r3 investigator (2026-10-17). Not bends: 13/14/15/18/22/23/26 thickness/edge strips, 16/17/19/20/21/24/27 bend-arc facets, 25/28 fragments. Prep unchanged (label_prep); B5 needs an extent override because the plate is warped up to ~1.5 mm along that fold and the 0.6 mm patch gate cuts the auto extent to 7.6 mm.

bends.note: front flange 5/8, 90 deg up, runs the whole front edge (fold ~398 mm on full-res sections)
left leg 6/7, 90 deg down; fold ~47.5 mm from the front corner relief to the back relief
right leg 3/4, ~110 deg down (tucked under the plate), larger radius; inner-skin pair because the outer pair 2-4 gets too little leg support in the default zone; fold ~47.7 mm
right-back tab 11/12, 90 deg down; inner-skin pair because the plate top skin is missing from the scan near this fold; fold ~51 mm

left-back tab 9/10, ~66 deg down; plate warped up to ~1.5 mm along this fold, so the 0.6 mm patch gate cut the auto extent to t 17.7..25.3; extent set to the tab side edges (t 17.5..68.5 on full-res sections), same sides and margin so line_origin is unchanged
